body: ## Pull request overview Updates the `EditorSettings` class reference to better describe how JetBrains Mono’s OpenType features are used by the editor, and clarifies the limitations of the bundled JetBrains Mono regarding OpenType variations (variable-font axes). **Changes:** - Replaces the “no documented list yet” note with a link to JetBrains Mono’s documented OpenType feature list and clarifies the ligatures setting behavior. - Updates the note for custom variations to explain that the bundled JetBrains Mono is not variable, so variation axes won’t have an effect by default. --- 💡 Add a `code-review` agent skill or configure MCP servers for context-aware, tailored reviews. Learn more in the docs.
